title: 不匹配就暂停并保留证据
premise: 接班方确认隔离和权限边界，明确失败时联系谁及不得做什么。
listeningTask: 抓住数据不匹配、日志缺口和时间超标的不同处理。

lines.en: Recovery escalation starts with me tonight. Page the backup if I'm unreachable.
lines.zh: 今晚恢复异常先找我，联系不上就呼叫后备。

lines.en: What should halt the validation work? Data mismatch, missing logs, or unsafe access?
lines.zh: 什么情况暂停验证？数据不匹配、缺日志还是不安全访问？

lines.en: Any of those means stop and preserve evidence. No manual row corrections to pass.
lines.zh: 任何一种都停止并保留证据，不能手工改行让检查通过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no production promotion, right? A failed drill stays isolated throughout.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不提升成生产，对吧？失败演练全程保持隔离。

lines.en: And archived WAL gaps need source review. Don't invent a newer target instead.
lines.zh: 归档日志缺口需要复查来源，不能擅自换成更新恢复点。

lines.en: The escalation path includes backup storage owner. I'll attach their approved contact entry.
lines.zh: 升级路径也包括备份存储负责人，我附上批准联系人记录。

lines.en: What's the ETA if reconciliation stalls? We need a reporting deadline as well.
lines.zh: 对账卡住时预计何时更新？还需要报告期限。

lines.en: Update at four ten even if unfinished. Maybe sooner for any data mismatch.
lines.zh: 即使未完成也四点十分更新，数据不匹配则更早。

lines.en: The time target is already missed. That needs review, not unsafe shortcuts.
lines.zh: 耗时目标已未达标，需要评审，不是走不安全捷径。

lines.en: So, preserve logs and exact job outputs. We'll investigate before restarting the drill.
lines.zh: 那保留日志和准确任务输出，重做演练前先调查。
